scope: 主线 HyperOS 原盘准备与一次性 LKL bootstrap 修复；本机功能和 iOS 编译检查，设备执行与整机性能待验证

data.scope: Native 1-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
data.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.
